briefing: - 今日清单未标记在野利用或勒索软件关联。
- 批量公告集中在缺失认证、硬编码密钥及RCE，需警惕横向扩散。
- 最优先处置：两枚CVSS 10.0漏洞，含代码注入RCE与CWE-426。
- OA栈溢出、数据库越界写入/UAF等9.8-9.9漏洞，需快修。

items.title: Netcore NR256CN预认证栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向任意/router/*.cgi发送超长Basic用户名触发栈溢出，可致进程崩溃或执行代码。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁；临时限制/router/*.cgi对外访问，避免设备暴露公网
items.repro_note: 请求任意/router/*.cgi并带Basic头，用户名超63字节触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 网络路由器,常暴露于公网边界
items.description: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a pre-authentication stack overflow vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_ok() function, which copies Basic-auth usernames with unbounded strcpy() calls into 64-byte stack buffers. Unauthenticated attackers can send a username longer than 63 bytes to any protected /router/*.cgi route to crash the main Boa process or potentially execute code.

items.title: EseeCloud设备硬编码凭据登录
items.summary_zh: 攻击者使用内置硬编码凭据即可登录EseeCloud设备，未授权获取摄像头视频与管理权限。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商升级固件；无法升级时移出公网、限制访问并修改默认口令
items.repro_note: 用已知硬编码账号密码连接设备管理端口或登录接口验证
items.impact_scope: 物联网摄像头,大量暴露公网
items.description: An attacker can use a hard-coded credential to log in to EseeCloud devices.

items.title: WeRSS 模板注入未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者通过GET /rss/{feed_id}的template参数注入表达式，绕过过滤执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至 1.5.3 之后版本；暂无补丁前禁止外网访问并过滤 template 参数
items.repro_note: 未授权 GET /rss/{feed_id}，template 参数注入表达式
items.impact_scope: 公众号RSS服务,常暴露公网
items.description: WeRSS (we-mp-rss) through 1.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run code via the template parameter of the public GET /rss/{feed_id} endpoint. Attackers can supply a non-built-in ext value and a {{=expression}} template whose object-subclass traversal bypasses the eval denylist to run OS commands as the service account.

items.title: WhaTicket Community 未授权 权限提升
items.description: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to self-register as administrators via POST /auth/signup. Attackers can omit the profile field or set it to admin, gaining user management, settings, and access to all tickets, contacts, messages, and WhatsApp connections.

items.title: The Grid主题代码注入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者利用 The Grid 主题代码注入缺陷执行命令，可完全控制站点服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级 The Grid 主题至 2.8.1 之后版本；暂无补丁前停用该主题
items.impact_scope: WordPress站点,公网自建站
items.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Theme-one The Grid the-grid allows Command Injection.This issue affects The Grid: from n/a through 2.8.1.

items.title: DeepSeek dsh 不受信路径RCE
items.summary_zh: 本地攻击者将恶意可执行文件放入不受信搜索路径并诱导用户打开，即以用户权限执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 更新 dsh 至修复提交版本；暂无法升级时避免从不可信目录启动
items.repro_note: 将同名恶意可执行文件置于 dsh 搜索路径，诱导用户打开触发执行
items.impact_scope: 开发者本地工具,需用户交互
items.description: An untrusted search path in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) commit c291e796 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via supplying and opening crafted executable files in place of legitimate content.

items.title: MariaDB GIS对象越界写入
items.summary_zh: 低权限远程账号提交特制GIS对象触发越界写，配合其他漏洞可实现远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 关注 MariaDB 官方补丁升级修复版本，并限制普通账号权限
items.repro_note: 低权限账号提交特制GIS对象，观察内存破坏；需配合其他漏洞实现RCE
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务器,需低权限账号
items.description: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. A low-privileged remote attacker can submit a specially crafted GIS object to corrupt memory and potentially achieve code execution when combined with another vulnerability.

items.title: MariaDB 游标释放后重用UAF
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户批量打开SYS_REFCURSOR后取数触发释放后重用，配合其他漏洞可执行代码。
items.action_zh: 关注官方补丁升级修复版本，并限制低权限账号的游标查询能力
items.repro_note: 低权限账号批量打开SYS_REFCURSOR后fetch一个触发UAF
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务器,需低权限账号
items.description: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 12.3.1 until 12.3.3 and 13.0.2, SYS_REFCURSOR handling is affected because cursor-array reallocation can leave stale references in routine contexts. A low-privileged attacker can open a large number of SYS_REFCURSORs and then fetch one to trigger a use-after-free that can enable remote code execution when combined with another vulnerability. This issue is fixed in versions 12.3.3 and 13.0.2.

items.title: MariaDB #mysql50#前缀绕过编码
items.summary_zh: 低权限账号用#mysql50#前缀建表可绕过表名文件系统编码，存在越权访问数据文件的可能。
items.repro_note: 以低权限账号创建带#mysql50#前缀的表名，观察文件系统编码绕过
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务器,需建表权限
items.description: From 10.6.1 until 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, the #mysql50# bypass prefix is affected because it allows the #mysql50# prefix to bypass normal table-name filesystem encoding. An attacker can trigger the issue with a table name using the #mysql50# prefix, then use a #mysql50# table name to access files under their legacy unencoded name and cause crashes, data corruption, data exfiltration, or remote code execution.

items.title: DHCPv6客户端IA_PD越界读取
items.summary_zh: 恶意或被控DHCPv6服务器返回畸形IA_PD选项，触发堆越界读，可致设备崩溃并可能泄露内存。
items.action_zh: 升级含修复的固件；暂无补丁时关闭 IA_PD 相关 DHCPv6 客户端模块
items.repro_note: 伪造DHCPv6服务器向客户端回送带过短IA_PD选项的REPLY报文
items.impact_scope: 嵌入式网络设备,需邻近或中间人
items.description: RIOT is an open-source microcontroller operating system designed for Internet of Things devices and other embedded systems. A malicious or compromised DHCPv6 server can send a REPLY with an option length smaller than the required structure while MODULE_DHCPV6_CLIENT_IA_PD is enabled, causing _parse_ia_pd_option to read past the option body, size_t underflow, and unbounded out-of-bounds heap reads that can crash the device and may expose or corrupt memory.

items.title: Damselfly API缺失认证可接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可直接访问全部/api/*接口，创建管理员或重置任意用户密码，完全接管系统。
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本；暂无补丁前为 /api/* 增加鉴权并限制外网访问
items.repro_note: 未授权 PUT /api/users 建Admin账号，或重置任意用户密码
items.impact_scope: 自托管图像管理后台,内网资产
items.description: Webreaper Damselfly through 4.5.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access all /api/* routes because controller authorization attributes are commented out. Attackers can send PUT /api/users with Admin roles to create administrator accounts, or POST /api/users to reset any user's password, gaining full control.

items.title: Misaka弹幕服务器配置接口未授权
items.title_zh: Misaka弹幕服务器配置接口未授权
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可通过配置回滚接口写入ipWhitelist等键值，冒充管理员访问所有受保护接口。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；暂无补丁前限制该接口访问并补充鉴权
items.repro_note: 未授权调用配置回滚接口，写入ipWhitelist为自身地址
items.impact_scope: 弹幕服务后台,内网自托管
items.description: Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary configuration keys via the unprotected POST /api/ui/config-history/rollback endpoint. Attackers can set the ipWhitelist key to their own /32 address, or alter trustedProxies and webhookApiKey, to access every protected endpoint as the administrator.

items.title: IceCMS 用户接口未授权账号接管
items.title_zh: IceCMS 用户接口未授权账号接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向/User/updateUser提交新密码与角色，可接管任意账号含管理员。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；暂无补丁前为 /User/** 补充鉴权并禁止公网访问
items.repro_note: 未授权PUT /User/updateUser改userId的密码与角色
items.impact_scope: Java CMS后台,内网自托管
items.description: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify, delete, or disable any account because /User/** is excluded from the Shiro jwt filter. Attackers can send PUT requests to /User/updateUser to set a new password and role on any userId, including administrators, enabling full account takeover.

items.title: Simple Admin 硬编码JWT密钥
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用配置文件中硬编码的AccessSecret伪造管理员JWT，接管全部后台功能。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本并轮换 AccessSecret 配置；无补丁时改用随机强密钥
items.repro_note: 读取core.yaml的AccessSecret自签roleId=001的JWT
items.impact_scope: Go后台管理框架,内网多部署
items.description: Simple Admin Core through 1.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge super administrator tokens by using the hard-coded Auth.AccessSecret in api/etc/core.yaml. Attackers can sign a JWT with the public secret and roleId claim 001 to gain full administrative control over users, roles, menus, API authorities, configuration and tokens.

items.title: DataBuff硬编码HMAC密钥伪造令牌
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用内置HMAC密钥伪造管理员令牌，可访问/webapi全部接口并查询数据库。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本并更换默认 HMAC 密钥；暂无补丁前限制外网访问
items.repro_note: 用默认dev-secret签发admin令牌，请求/webapi受保护接口
items.impact_scope: APM监控后台,内网自托管
items.description: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin session tokens by using the hardcoded HMAC secret in JwtTokenService. Attackers can sign a payload of admin and a future expiry with the default dev-secret to gain full administrative access to protected /webapi routes, including the Doris SQL query API.

items.title: DataBuff内置默认口令可登管理员
items.title_zh: DataBuff内置默认口令可登管理员
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用内置admin/Databuff@123登录认证接口获取管理员令牌，接管全部后台。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本并立即修改默认口令；暂无补丁前限制外网访问
items.repro_note: 用内置 admin/Databuff@123 调用登录接口获取管理员令牌
items.impact_scope: APM监控后台,内网自托管
items.description: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access using the built-in admin/Databuff@123 account. Attackers can POST these credentials to /webapi/api/v1/auth/login to obtain an administrator token and access all protected /webapi routes.

items.title: LangChat 缺失认证泄露口令密钥
items.title_zh: LangChat 缺失认证泄露口令密钥
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可读取/api/v1/auth/users明文口令与模型密钥，创建超管并篡改数据。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；暂无补丁前为 REST 接口启用 Sa-Token 鉴权
items.repro_note: 未授权 GET /api/v1/auth/users 读取明文口令与密钥
items.impact_scope: AI聊天平台后端,内网自托管
items.description: LangChat through commit 2a6285a contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access REST controllers because no Sa-Token interceptor is registered. Attackers can query /api/v1/auth/users to read plaintext passwords, retrieve LLM provider API keys, create super-admin accounts, and modify or delete data.

items.title: Crafty审计日志头注入存储XSS
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者通过HTTP头注入向审计日志写入脚本，管理员查看日志时触发存储型XSS。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: GitLab(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本；暂无补丁前对日志输出转义并过滤请求头
items.repro_note: 在可入库的HTTP头中注入脚本，登录后台查看审计日志触发XSS
items.impact_scope: 游戏服务器面板,内网运维后台
items.description: An output escaping vulnerability in the Audit Logs component of Crafty Controller allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to perform stored cross-site scripting via HTTP header injection

items.title: RIOT Wi-Fi畸形SSID栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 邻近攻击者广播超长畸形SSID，启用动态连接模块的设备扫描时栈溢出，可致崩溃或执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级 RIOT 修复版本；无法升级时关闭 ATWINC15X0 动态连接模块
items.repro_note: 开启ATWINC15X0动态连接后广播超长SSID，触发扫描解析溢出
items.impact_scope: 物联网嵌入式设备,需无线邻近
items.description: RIOT is an open-source microcontroller operating system designed for Internet of Things devices and other embedded systems. When MODULE_ATWINC15X0_DYNAMIC_CONNECT is enabled, a nearby attacker can advertise a malformed or oversized SSID that is processed during Wi-Fi scanning, causing memory corruption and potentially a hard fault, denial of service, or code execution.

items.title: 容器管理组件缺失认证致命令执行
items.title_zh: 容器管理组件缺失认证致命令执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者调用无鉴权接口在容器内执行命令，存在敏感挂载或特权容器时可影响宿主。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；暂无补丁前限制相关接口暴露并禁用特权容器
items.repro_note: 未授权调用容器管理接口提交命令执行请求，验证容器内可达性
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚拟化平台,横向跳板
items.description: When an unauthenticated attacker has network reach to Dockhand, knows a target container ID, and targets a container with an interactive shell, the attacker can open a raw WebSocket terminal session and execute commands inside a known target container. This allows unauthenticated command execution inside the container, with possible host compromise when the container has sensitive mounts or privileged execution.

items.title: Green Popups 盲SQL注入漏洞
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过受影响参数实施盲SQL注入，读取数据库敏感信息，影响使用该插件的站点。
items.action_zh: 升级 Green Popups 至 7.6.3；无法升级则停用插件。
items.impact_scope: CMS插件，站点数据库风险
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in halfdata Green Popups halfdata-green-popups allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Green Popups: from n/a before 7.6.3.

items.title: TSG Profleet SQL注入可读写数据
items.title_zh: TSG Profleet SQL注入可读写数据
items.summary_zh: 经 Identificación 参数注入 SQL，攻击者可读取、篡改或删除 Profleet 数据库数据。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取修复版本；限制 /cgi-bin/index.php 访问并过滤参数。
items.repro_note: 向 /cgi-bin/index.php 发送 GET 请求，构造 Identificación 参数注入 SQL。
items.impact_scope: 车队管理系统，数据库数据风险
items.description: An SQL injection vulnerability has been discovered in TSG Profleet. The vulnerability could allow an attacker to retrieve, create, update and delete data from the database by sending a GET request using the ‘Identificación’ parameter of the ‘/cgi-bin/index.php’ endpoint.

items.title: Claude SDK 参数注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 应用将不可信输入作为 session ID 传参时，攻击者可注入 --mcp-config 定义 MCP 服务，导致任意命令执行。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级 claude-agent-sdk 到 0.2.121；校验 session ID。
items.repro_note: 恶意 session ID 传入 resume，注入 --mcp-config 执行命令。
items.impact_scope: Python SDK，集成应用命令执行风险
items.description: An attacker can inject the --mcp-config flag to define a stdio MCP server, causing arbitrary command execution at CLI startup outside the SDK permission controls. The issue is exploitable when an application passes untrusted input as the session ID to resume.

items.title: DICOM归档缺失认证访问
items.summary_zh: 未注册 AE 可远程关联 DICOM 归档，枚举获取患者影像，并可伪造影像写入已有患者。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；启用调用 AE 注册白名单并限制 DICOM 端口。
items.repro_note: 向 DICOM 归档发送未注册 AE 的 C-FIND/C-GET/C-STORE 请求。
items.impact_scope: 医疗影像归档，患者隐私数据风险
items.description: In the default configuration, the archive accepts DICOM associations from an unregistered calling AE. A remote peer can use C-FIND and C-GET to enumerate and retrieve patient information and medical images. It can also use C-STORE to file fabricated study content under an existing patient identity.

items.title: DICOM存储状态越权删除
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可调用存储状态 REST 服务，将关联 DICOM 实例的 location 置为 TO_DELETE，导致对象被删除。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商修复；限制 REST 接口权限并校验删除条件。
items.repro_note: 调用存储状态 REST 接口，将 location 置为 TO_DELETE 删除对象。
items.impact_scope: 医疗影像存储，数据删除风险
items.description: The storage status-change REST service allows location records still associated with DICOM instances to be changed to deletion-related states. Changing a location to TO_DELETE causes PurgeStorageScheduler to delete the referenced object from storage even though the corresponding instance record remains in the database.

items.title: nanocoap Block2整数溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程 CoAP 客户端可发送超大 Block2 选项，在 32 位目标触发整数溢出与越界访问，导致崩溃或内存破坏。
items.action_zh: 升级至 2026.07 或更高；限制 CoAP 暴露并校验 Block2 选项。
items.repro_note: 向 CoAP 服务发送超范围 Block2 选项，触发 32 位溢出越界访问。
items.impact_scope: CoAP 服务/物联网设备，DoS风险
items.description: Prior to 2026.07, nanocoap accepts oversized CoAP Block2 option values without enforcing the 20-bit maximum block number, allowing block offset multiplication to overflow on 32-bit targets. A remote CoAP client can send a malformed Block2 option that produces an invalid slice range and can cause out-of-bounds memory access, denial of service, or memory corruption.

items.title: Star Rating 上传存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 非全局应用管理员可通过 uploadFeedbackFile 上传伪装 MIME 的活跃内容，形成存储型 XSS 影响其他用户。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级到 24.05.50 或 25.03.44；限制上传文件类型与 MIME 校验。
items.repro_note: 管理员调用 uploadFeedbackFile 上传含脚本文件并伪造 MIME，访问触发 XSS。
items.impact_scope: 应用插件，用户会话/后台风险
items.description: Prior to 24.05.50 and 25.03.44, plugins/star-rating/api/api.js allows a non-global application administrator to use uploadFeedbackFile to store attacker-controlled active content while trusting the supplied MIME type.

items.title: ZoneMinder 命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可触发 ZoneMinder 命令注入，以 Web 服务器用户身份执行任意命令，导致主机被控。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；限制 ZoneMinder 暴露并过滤命令参数。
items.repro_note: 定位 ZoneMinder 命令注入入口，构造恶意参数以 Web 用户身份执行命令。
items.impact_scope: 视频监控系统，常暴露内网/公网
items.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Arbitrary commands execute as the web server user.
